name: Zenn Foulhoof
summary: Zenn Foulhoof is an exiled satyr lingering just east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. While he feigns innocence to passersby and tries to trick young adventurers into helping him, the local night elves keep a close eye on his scheming. Though tolerated for a time through minor punishments, his affinity for dark magic makes him an unwelcome presence on the boughs of the World Tree.

sections.title: A Schemer in the Woods
sections.body: Unlike most satyrs, who are outright hostiles serving demonic masters, Zenn Foulhoof somehow secured a tenuous tolerance just outside Dolanaar. He maintains a friendly facade, claiming he has changed or wants to trade in harmless forest reagents like spider fangs and tiger lily scents. In reality, he manipulates gullible youths to procure ingredients for foul rituals. Dolanaar's council refuses to let him operate unchecked; rather than executing him immediately, they order adventurers to humiliate him by feeding him corrupted forest fruit, temporarily transforming the scheming satyr into a harmless frog.

sections.title: Exile to Darkshore
sections.body: Zenn's petty trickery in Teldrassil quickly escalates into dangerous corruption. After being thoroughly chased out of the World Tree for his dark magic, he establishes a lair in Cliffspring Hollow near Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore. Stripping away all pretense of repentance, Zenn allies with grell and rogue alchemists, actively spreading a foul blight that maddens the local wildlife until Tharnariun Treetender marks him for death.

faq.q: Why isn't Zenn Foulhoof immediately attacked by the night elves?
aliases: why don't night elves kill zenn
faq.answer: Zenn maintains a friendly veneer and has not yet openly committed atrocities on the World Tree, leading the council of Dolanaar to discipline him through public humiliation and watchfulness rather than an immediate death sentence.

faq.q: What happens when you feed Zenn the corrupted cones and berries?
faq.answer: As penance ordered by the elders of Dolanaar, an adventurer forces Zenn to ingest the tainted woodland flora he sought to exploit. The foul magic backfires instantly, turning him into a small, squawking frog.

faq.q: Where does Zenn Foulhoof go after leaving Teldrassil?
aliases: where is zenn foulhoof in darkshore
faq.answer: Once driven off the World Tree, Zenn flees to Darkshore and takes up residence in Cliffspring Hollow near Cliffspring Falls, abandoning all deception and actively corrupting the forest's bears and rats.

Satyrs are night elves who were warped into horned, cloven-hoofed fiends during the War of the Ancients after pledging service to the Burning Legion. Most are utterly corrupted and violently hostile to their uncorrupted kin.

angles.text: Satyrs represent the ultimate betrayal of kaldorei heritage. Seeing one lounging on the sacred boughs of Teldrassil is an insult to Elune and the spirits of the wild.
Zenn's tampering with wild reagents and deliberate spreading of corrupting taints directly offends Cenarion teachings, which seek to keep Teldrassil pristine.
